description: Retrieves a list of alerts (workflows) for a Sentry organization. Use to get alert configurations, statuses, and trigger details. ⚠️ Note: This endpoint is currently in beta and may be subject to change. It is supported by New Monitors and Alerts and may not be viewable in the UI today.

id.description: The ID of the alert you'd like to query. Can specify multiple IDs.
id.title: Id

organization_id_or_slug.description: The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.
organization_id_or_slug.title: Organization Id Or Slug

project.description: The IDs of projects to filter by. Use `[-1]` to include all available projects. For example: `[1234, 56789]` or `[-1]`.
project.title: Project

query.description: An optional search query for filtering alerts.
query.title: Query

sortBy.description: The field to sort results by. If not specified, the results are sorted by id. Available fields are: `name`, `id`, `dateCreated`, `dateUpdated`, `connectedDetectors`, `actions`, `priorityDetector`. Prefix with `-` to sort in descending order (e.g., `-dateCreated`).
sortBy.title: Sort By

name: fetch_alerts

actionFilters.description: Filters that determine when actions should be performed.
actionFilters.title: Action Filters

createdBy.description: ID of the user who created the alert.
createdBy.title: Created By

dateCreated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the alert was created.
dateCreated.title: Date Created

dateUpdated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the alert was last updated.
dateUpdated.title: Date Updated

detectorIds.description: List of detector IDs connected to this alert.
detectorIds.title: Detector Ids

enabled.description: Whether the alert is currently enabled.
enabled.title: Enabled

environment.description: Environment name associated with the alert (e.g., production).
environment.title: Environment

lastTriggered.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the alert was last triggered.
lastTriggered.title: Last Triggered

organizationId.description: Organization ID that owns this alert.
organizationId.title: Organization Id

actions.description: Actions to perform when the trigger fires.
actions.title: Actions

conditions.description: Conditions that must be met for the trigger to fire.
conditions.title: Conditions

logicType.description: Logic type for the trigger conditions.
logicType.title: Logic Type

organizationId.description: Organization ID associated with the trigger.
organizationId.title: Organization Id

FetchAlertsResponse.description: Response schema for `FetchAlerts` containing a list of alerts.

data.description: List of alerts for the organization.
data.title: Data

FetchAlertsResponse.title: FetchAlertsResponse
